issuer_name: Greenland Mines Ltd (formerly Klotho Neurosciences, Inc.)
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Issuer pivoted in March 2026 via acquisition of Greenland Mines Corp into critical/precious-minerals mining. Legacy biopharma assets are: (a) five already-marketed generic anti-cancer drugs (FOLFOX/FOLFIRI components) acquired Sept 2022 — these are commercial generics in Germany, not pipeline candidates; (b) two off-patent biosimilar antibodies in-licensed from Reliance Life Sciences — also commercial-stage; (c) Klotho gene therapy platform (KLTO-202) — preclinical, no IND filed yet (10-K states 'we have not yet submitted any IND applications in connection with any gene therapies'; partner Jocasta Therapeutics expects to file IND in 2026 for s-KL). No active sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical trials. CT.gov returns zero records for sponsor 'Greenland Mines'.

website.error: no public pharma pipeline page — corporate identity now mining-focused

commercial_product.note: Five FOLFOX/FOLFIRI cytotoxic generics market-approved in Germany (5-FU, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, irinotecan family for metastatic colorectal/gastric/lung cancer); two biosimilar antibodies in-licensed from Reliance Life Sciences. Commercial generics, not pipeline.

excluded_preclinical: KLTO-202 (Klotho gene therapy) — preclinical, IND-pending; toxicology package planned
s-KL (secreted Klotho) program — partnered to Jocasta Therapeutics, Jocasta expects IND filing in 2026
